result.title: Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for spatial text-to-image generation, but existing work largely focuses on policy optimization, assuming accurate rewards and effective online rollouts. We observe in-domain gains with out-of-domain degradation, exposing two limitations: unreliable spatial rewards in open-world settings and rollouts lacking basic-to-complex progression. We propose a curriculum-guided RL framework. First, we introduce SpatialCritic, an agentic reward model equipped with a spatial perception harness that combines reusable verification guidance with specialized vision tools. We then construct spatial preference datasets through targeted counterfactual perturbations and perform agent-harness alignment to improve tool selection and evidence integration efficiently. Second, curriculum learning organizes shared foundational capabilities and their compositional dependencies in a capability graph for mastery-guided rollouts, periodic review, and targeted remediation. On SpaRW-Eval, SpatialCritic achieves 95.1% verification accuracy, outperforming 320B GLM-5.3-Flash with a 40x smaller 8B backbone and raising average baseline scores from 78.4 to 83.9 on SD3.5-Medium and 83.2 to 86.5 on BAGEL. Project page: https://xiaofeng-tan.github.io/projects/spatialcritic/

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对空间文生图强化学习中奖励不可靠、rollout 缺少由易到难进阶的问题，提出课程引导的 RL 框架：用带空间感知工具链的 agentic 奖励模型 SpatialCritic 做验证，并以能力图组织掌握度驱动的 rollout 与补救。
AI.relevance_reason: 其专用视觉工具、反事实偏好数据构造以及工具选择与证据整合对齐，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选和验证式监督设计提供方法线索；但对象是图像生成奖励而非推理状态，可迁移性待核查。
